auth.consent.title: Your organisation has not approved this app yet
auth.consent.body: This report only reads Microsoft 365 data, but a Global Administrator has to grant admin consent once before anyone in your tenant can use it.
auth.consent.linkTail: — you will be asked to review the read-only permissions this report needs, then returned here.
errors.insufficientPermissions: Insufficient permissions — admin consent or the required role may be needed for this report.
access.consent.title: Your organisation has not approved this app yet
access.consent.body: Approving sign-in is not enough: the report reads your tenant with application permissions, which a Global Administrator has to grant once for the whole tenant. Signing in again will not help until they do.
access.permissions.intro: The grant covers these read-only permissions, and Microsoft lists the same ones on its consent page:
access.permissions.reports: Microsoft 365 usage reports: storage per site and per OneDrive
access.permissions.organization: tenant name and licences, for the storage entitlement
access.tenant.title: This tenant is not enabled for the report yet
access.tenant.body: You signed in successfully, but your tenant has not been switched on for this report. No role or consent will change that — ask Proventeq to enable it.
access.permission.title: Your account cannot read usage reports
access.permission.body: You are signed in and your organisation has approved the app, but reading tenant usage reports needs an administrative role. Microsoft requires Global Reader, Reports Reader, or an equivalent role — ask an administrator to assign one.
table.column.help.site: The site's display name and a link to it, looked up in the tenant site directory because Microsoft's usage report leaves the URL blank. A site the signed-in account cannot open, or one that has been deleted, shows its owner and site id instead.
table.column.help.drive: The OneDrive account, named after its owner, with a link to the drive.
table.column.help.owner: The primary owner as Microsoft's usage report records it. For group-connected sites this is the Microsoft 365 group's owners.
table.column.help.files: Files stored, as of the report date.
table.column.help.active: Files that were created, edited or otherwise active during the 180-day reporting period.
table.column.help.used: Storage consumed, as Microsoft's usage report measures it, as of the report date.
table.column.help.share: This row's storage as a percentage of everything this table covers. The bar is drawn to the same scale.
table.column.help.lastActivity: The most recent day with file activity in the 180-day reporting period. Never means no activity was recorded in that period.
table.column.help.template: The SharePoint template the site was created from. Team Channel and Group templates count as Teams in the workload split; everything else counts as SharePoint.
table.column.help.capacity: How much of the drive's own storage allocation is used — the per-user cap a OneDrive can actually hit. Blank for sites, whose allocation is the 25 TB site-collection maximum rather than a quota.

storageOptimisation.description: A consolidated summary of tenant storage — where it sits today, where it is heading, and what drives it.
storageOptimisation.capacity.title: Tenant capacity
storageOptimisation.capacity.subtitle: Tenant-wide Microsoft 365 storage measured against your licensed entitlement
storageOptimisation.kpi.costOfNothingHin: Added spend per year on growth beyond your entitlement, valued at {rate}/GB per month. Zero while growth stays within it.
storageOptimisation.kpi.forecastInsuffic: Too few months of measured growth
storageOptimisation.distribution.title: Current storage distribution
storageOptimisation.distribution.subtitl: Where storage sits today — quota usage, workload split, and which site types drive the volume
storageOptimisation.quota.title: Quota usage
storageOptimisation.quota.scopeNote: Tenant-wide usage against the Microsoft 365 entitlement
storageOptimisation.quota.entitlementUnk: Tenant entitlement unavailable, so quota usage cannot be shown
storageOptimisation.workload.title: Storage by workload
storageOptimisation.workload.subtitle: SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive, as reported by Microsoft 365
storageOptimisation.workload.groupingNot: Grouped by site template, which is what Microsoft Graph reports. These counts will not match the SharePoint admin centre, which groups differently.
storageOptimisation.template.title: Storage by site template
storageOptimisation.template.subtitle: SharePoint storage grouped by the template each site was created from
storageOptimisation.growth.sectionSubtit: Where storage is heading at the current growth rate — and what it costs if nothing changes
storageOptimisation.growth.forecastIndet: Not enough history to forecast capacity
There are too few months of measured growth to project a trajectory. This is not an all-clear — the forecast will appear once more history has accumulated.
storageOptimisation.growth.alreadyExhaus: The tenant is already using more than its pooled entitlement, so there is no future exhaustion date to project. Procurement or cleanup is needed now.
storageOptimisation.growth.forecastUnava: Capacity forecast unavailable without tenant entitlement
The tenant storage quota could not be read, so headroom and exhaustion cannot be projected. Enter your real entitlement in settings to see them.
storageOptimisation.growth.estimatedQuot: Your storage quota was estimated from licence counts rather than read from Microsoft, so the headroom and cost figures are approximate.
storageOptimisation.growth.volatileNote: The monthly figures the rate is derived from are uneven — one month dominates rather than a steady trend — so a single average is a weak guide here. Treat the projection as indicative.
storageOptimisation.growth.impactNote: At the current growth rate the tenant is projected to pass its pooled entitlement on this trajectory. Procurement or cleanup is needed before then.
storageOptimisation.growth.impactNoteNoA: At the current growth rate the tenant is projected to pass its pooled entitlement on this trajectory, but not for years — capacity needs no action today.
storageOptimisation.growth.noExhaustionN: At the current growth rate the tenant stays within its pooled entitlement for at least the next {years} years.
storageOptimisation.growth.costSubtitle: Extra spend once storage grows past the entitlement, at the configured rate.
storageOptimisation.offenders.title: Main offenders
storageOptimisation.offenders.subtitle: The sites and drives driving the most storage
storageOptimisation.offenders.retainedNo: {count} sites and drives are deleted but still consuming quota under retention.
storageOptimisation.offenders.allSubtitl: Every site and drive in the usage reports, sortable and searchable
storageOptimisation.concealedNamesNote: Your tenant conceals user and site names in usage reports, so identities below appear as hashes. The storage figures are unaffected. To show real names: Microsoft 365 admin centre → Settings → Org settings → Reports → uncheck "Display concealed user, group, and site names".
